stem: 1 month child weighed 5kg, needs maintenance fluids, what do you want to give. Guidelines are;

options.text: For children under 3 months use 0.9% NaCl + 10% glucose
To make up glucose use 50% glucose solution, work out volume by (% needed - %in solution used) X 20, for 1L normal saline
